Name: Ablative Armor
Description: Infuses armor to absorb 5 damage from the next attack (like DR 5/-), increasing by 1 per caster level (to a maximum of 15)

Name: Armor Enhancement, Lesser
Components: S, M (ointment of rare spices, 10 gp)
Description: Grants a suit of armor or shield resistance 10 to one energy type (as with Protection from Energy) for 10 min/level when worn by a construct:contentReference

Name: Energy Alteration
Components: An alchemical ointment formed from materials representing all five energy types and costing 50 gp.
Description: You alter an item that employs an energy type or grants protection from an energy type, to employ or protect against a different energy type.

Name: Indisputable Possession
Description: Creates a bond to a touched object: if it leaves your possession, you can call it back to your hand as a move action (a creature holding it gets a Will save to resist)

Name: Pending Potion
Components: S, M (needles from an evergreen tree)
Description: Destroys a prepared potion to delay its effect; the potion’s effect occurs up to 1 minute later when the caster speaks its name

Name: Weapon Augmentation, Personal
Description: Gives a weapon one special ability up to +1 bonus (such as Flaming or Keen) for 10 min/level, only uable by caster.

Name: Lucky Blade
Description: Imbues a weapon to let its wielder once reroll an attack roll (or critical confirmation) and must take the new result

Name: Reinforce Construct
Description: Grants a target construct 1d6+1 temporary hit points per level (max +10) that last until the end of the next round

Name: Suppress Dragonmark
Components: S, F (25 gp inversely charged Siberys shard)
Description: An inversely attuned Siberys shard absorbs a creature’s dragonmark energy, preventing that target from using any dragonmark spell-like abilities for 24 hours (Will negates)

Name: Weapon Augmentation, Lesser
Description: Gives a weapon one special ability up to +1 bonus (such as Flaming or Keen) for 10 min/level

Name: Adamantine Weapon
Description: Temporarily turns a metal weapon into adamantine for 10 min/level, letting it bypass hardness and ignore other special materials

Name: Armor Enhancement, Greater
Components: S, M (ointment of rare spices, 50 gp)
Description: Grants a suit of armor or shield one special quality (equivalent to a +1 enhancement, e.g. light fortification) for 10 min/level

Name: Blast Rod
Description: Stores up to 1d8 per level of energy (max 10d8) in a rod, which can later be released as one or more ranged touch attack blasts

Name: Construct Energy Ward
Description: Grants a construct resistance 10 to a specified energy type for 10 min/level (as with Protection from that energy)

Name: Lucky Cape
Description: Imbues a cloak to let its wearer once reroll a saving throw and must take the new result

Name: Spell Snare
Description: Enchants a dragonshard to absorb the next spell or spell-like ability of 3rd level or lower targeting its bearer; the spell is negated and the shard is destroyed.

Name: Total Repair
Description: Repairs 10 points per level of damage to a construct (as if casting Repair Serious Damage multiple times)

Name: Censure Elementals
Description: Imbues a held item so that all elementals within 20 ft take 2d4+1/level damage each round while it is wielded (Will halves; max +15)

Name: Concurrent Infusions
Components: S, M (oak twig with three forks)
Description: Allows you to imbue an object with three chosen 1st-level infusions at once; these do not count against your daily infusion uses

Name: Construct Energy Ward, Greater
Description: As lesser ward, but also grants one chosen special ability (up to +5 bonus value, e.g. etherealness) to the construct

Name: Repair Serious Damage
Description: Restores 3d8+1 per level (max +15) hit points to a construct:contentReference[oaicite:22]{index=22}.

Name: Stone Construct
Description: Turns a target into a living stone construct: it gains DR 10/adamantine and other construct traits

Name: Suppress Requirement
Description: Removes a specific prerequisite (class, race, alignment, etc.) from an item so it functions fully without it.

Name: Weapon Augmentation, Greater
Description: Gives a weapon one special ability up to +5 bonus (such as Vorpal) for 10 min/level:contentReference.

Name: Hardening
Description: Increases an item’s hardness by 1 for every 2 caster levels of the infusion:contentReference

Name: Iron Construct
Description: Enhances a construct: it gains DR 15/adamantine and takes only half normal damage from acid and fire

Name: Item Alteration
Description: Changes an item’s granted bonus type: the item provides one type of bonus instead of another of equal value (e.g. a Strength bonus instead of a Dexterity bonus)

Name: Slaying Arrow
Description: Imbues an arrow or bolt keyed to a chosen creature type: it gains +1 enhancement bonus, and a creature of that type struck must make a Fortitude save or be slain (undead/construct are also affected)

Name: Repair Critical Damage
Description: Restores 4d8+1 per level (max +20) hit points to a construct:contentReference

Name: Rusting Grasp
Description: Your touch causes metal to corrode: hit metal weapons or armor take 1d6 acid damage and may be destroyed on contact

Name: Shield of Faith, Legions
Description: Grants all allies within 30 feet a +3 sacred bonus to Armor Class

Name: Spell Snare, Greater
Description: As Spell Snare, but absorbs spells or abilities up to 6th level
